verses.en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.pt: Depois disso o Senhor respondeu a Jó dum redemoinho, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord made answer to Job out of the storm-wind, and said,

verses.en: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?
verses.pt: Quem é este que escurece o conselho com palavras sem conhecimento?
verses.en_web: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
verses.en_bbe: Who is this who makes the purpose of God dark by words without knowledge?

verses.en: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.
verses.pt: Agora cinge os teus lombos, como homem; porque te perguntarei, e tu me responderás.
verses.en_web: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!
verses.en_bbe: Get your strength together like a man of war; I will put questions to you, and you will give me the answers.

verses.en: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.
verses.pt: Onde estavas tu, quando eu lançava os fundamentos da terra? Faze-mo saber, se tens entendimento.
verses.en_web: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
verses.en_bbe: Where were you when I put the earth on its base? Say, if you have knowledge.

verses.en: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?
verses.pt: Quem lhe fixou as medidas, se é que o sabes? ou quem a mediu com o cordel?
verses.en_web: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?
verses.en_bbe: By whom were its measures fixed? Say, if you have wisdom; or by whom was the line stretched out over it?

verses.en: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;
verses.pt: Sobre que foram firmadas as suas bases, ou quem lhe assentou a pedra de esquina,
verses.en_web: Whereupon were its foundations fastened? Or who laid its cornerstone,
verses.en_bbe: On what were its pillars based, or who put down its angle-stone,

verses.en: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.pt: quando juntas cantavam as estrelas da manhã, e todos os filhos de Deus bradavam de júbilo?
verses.en_web: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.en_bbe: When the morning stars made songs together, and all the sons of the gods gave cries of joy?

verses.en: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?
verses.pt: Ou quem encerrou com portas o mar, quando este rompeu e saiu da madre;
verses.en_web: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
verses.en_bbe: Or where were you when the sea came to birth, pushing out from its secret place;

verses.en: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,
verses.pt: quando eu lhe pus nuvens por vestidura, e escuridão por faixas,
verses.en_web: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,
verses.en_bbe: When I made the cloud its robe, and put thick clouds as bands round it,

verses.en: And brake up for it my decreed place, and set bars and doors,
verses.pt: e lhe tracei limites, pondo-lhe portas e ferrolhos,
verses.en_web: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,
verses.en_bbe: Ordering a fixed limit for it, with locks and doors;

verses.en: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?
verses.pt: e lhe disse: Até aqui virás, porém não mais adiante; e aqui se quebrarão as tuas ondas orgulhosas?
verses.en_web: and said, ‘Here you may come, but no further. Here your proud waves shall be stayed?’
verses.en_bbe: And said, So far you may come, and no farther; and here the pride of your waves will be stopped?

verses.en: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;
verses.pt: Desde que começaram os teus dias, deste tu ordem à madrugada, ou mostraste à alva o seu lugar,
verses.en_web: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place;
verses.en_bbe: Have you, from your earliest days, given orders to the morning, or made the dawn conscious of its place;

verses.en: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?
verses.pt: para que agarrasse nas extremidades da terra, e os ímpios fossem sacudidos dela?
verses.en_web: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?
verses.en_bbe: So that it might take a grip of the skirts of the earth, shaking all the evil-doers out of it?

verses.en: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.
verses.pt: A terra se transforma como o barro sob o selo; e todas as coisas se assinalam como as cores dum vestido.
verses.en_web: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.
verses.en_bbe: It is changed like wet earth under a stamp, and is coloured like a robe;

verses.en: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.
verses.pt: E dos ímpios é retirada a sua luz, e o braço altivo se quebranta.
verses.en_web: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.
verses.en_bbe: And from the evil-doers their light is kept back, and the arm of pride is broken.

verses.en: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?
verses.pt: Acaso tu entraste até os mananciais do mar, ou passeaste pelos recessos do abismo?
verses.en_web: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?
verses.en_bbe: Have you come into the springs of the sea, walking in the secret places of the deep?

verses.en: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?
verses.pt: Ou foram-te descobertas as portas da morte, ou viste as portas da sombra da morte?
verses.en_web: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?
verses.en_bbe: Have the doors of death been open to you, or have the door-keepers of the dark ever seen you?

verses.en: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.
verses.pt: Compreendeste a largura da terra? Faze-mo saber, se sabes tudo isso.
verses.en_web: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.
verses.en_bbe: Have you taken note of the wide limits of the earth? Say, if you have knowledge of it all.

verses.en: Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,
verses.pt: Onde está o caminho para a morada da luz? E, quanto às trevas, onde está o seu lugar,
verses.en_web: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,
verses.en_bbe: Which is the way to the resting-place of the light, and where is the store-house of the dark;

verses.en: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?
verses.pt: para que às tragas aos seus limites, e para que saibas as veredas para a sua casa?
verses.en_web: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?
verses.en_bbe: So that you might take it to its limit, guiding it to its house?

verses.en: Knowest thou it, because thou wast then born? or because the number of thy days is great?
verses.pt: De certo tu o sabes, porque já então eras nascido, e porque é grande o número dos teus dias!
verses.en_web: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
verses.en_bbe: No doubt you have knowledge of it, for then you had come to birth, and the number of your days is great.

verses.en: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,
verses.pt: Acaso entraste nos tesouros da neve, e viste os tesouros da saraiva,
verses.en_web: Have you entered the treasuries of the snow, or have you seen the treasures of the hail,
verses.en_bbe: Have you come into the secret place of snow, or have you seen the store-houses of the ice-drops,

verses.en: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
verses.pt: que eu tenho reservado para o tempo da angústia, para o dia da peleja e da guerra?
verses.en_web: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
verses.en_bbe: Which I have kept for the time of trouble, for the day of war and fighting?

verses.en: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?
verses.pt: Onde está o caminho para o lugar em que se reparte a luz, e se espalha o vento oriental sobre a terra?
verses.en_web: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?
verses.en_bbe: Which is the way to the place where the wind is measured out, and the east wind sent out over the earth?

verses.en: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;
verses.pt: Quem abriu canais para o aguaceiro, e um caminho para o relâmpago do trovão;
verses.en_web: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm;
verses.en_bbe: By whom has the way been cut for the flowing of the rain, and the flaming of the thunder;

verses.en: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
verses.pt: para fazer cair chuva numa terra, onde não há ninguém, e no deserto, em que não há gente;
verses.en_web: To cause it to rain on a land where no man is; on the wilderness, in which there is no man;
verses.en_bbe: Causing rain to come on a land where no man is living, on the waste land which has no people;

verses.en: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
verses.pt: para fartar a terra deserta e assolada, e para fazer crescer a tenra relva?
verses.en_web: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?
verses.en_bbe: To give water to the land where there is waste and destruction, and to make the dry land green with young grass?

verses.en: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
verses.pt: A chuva porventura tem pai? Ou quem gerou as gotas do orvalho?
verses.en_web: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?
verses.en_bbe: Has the rain a father? or who gave birth to the drops of night mist?

verses.en: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?
verses.pt: Do ventre de quem saiu o gelo? E quem gerou a geada do céu?
verses.en_web: Out of whose womb came the ice? The gray frost of the sky, who has given birth to it?
verses.en_bbe: Out of whose body came the ice? and who gave birth to the cold mist of heaven?

verses.en: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.
verses.pt: Como pedra as águas se endurecem, e a superfície do abismo se congela.
verses.en_web: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.
verses.en_bbe: The waters are joined together, hard as a stone, and the face of the deep is covered.

verses.en: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?
verses.pt: Podes atar as cadeias das Plêiades, ou soltar os atilhos do Oriom?
verses.en_web: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?
verses.en_bbe: Are the bands of the Pleiades fixed by you, or are the cords of Orion made loose?

verses.en: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?
verses.pt: Ou fazer sair as constelações a seu tempo, e guiar a ursa com seus filhos?
verses.en_web: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?
verses.en_bbe: Do you make Mazzaroth come out in its right time, or are the Bear and its children guided by you?

verses.en: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?
verses.pt: Sabes tu as ordenanças dos céus, ou podes estabelecer o seu domínio sobre a terra?
verses.en_web: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?
verses.en_bbe: Have you knowledge of the laws of the heavens? did you give them rule over the earth?

verses.en: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?
verses.pt: Ou podes levantar a tua voz até as nuvens, para que a abundância das águas te cubra?
verses.en_web: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, That abundance of waters may cover you?
verses.en_bbe: Is your voice sent up to the cloud, so that you may be covered by the weight of waters?

verses.en: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?
verses.pt: Ou ordenarás aos raios de modo que saiam? Eles te dirão: Eis-nos aqui?
verses.en_web: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are?’
verses.en_bbe: Do you send out the thunder-flames, so that they may go, and say to you, Here we are?

verses.en: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?
verses.pt: Quem pôs sabedoria nas densas nuvens, ou quem deu entendimento ao meteoro?
verses.en_web: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?
verses.en_bbe: Who has put wisdom in the high clouds, or given knowledge to the lights of the north?

verses.en: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,
verses.pt: Quem numerará as nuvens pela sabedoria? Ou os odres do céu, quem os esvaziará,
verses.en_web: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the bottles of the sky,
verses.en_bbe: By whose wisdom are the clouds numbered, or the water-skins of the heavens turned to the earth,

verses.en: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?
verses.pt: quando se funde o pó em massa, e se pegam os torrões uns aos outros?
verses.en_web: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?
verses.en_bbe: When the earth becomes hard as metal, and is joined together in masses?

verses.en: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,
verses.pt: Podes caçar presa para a leoa, ou satisfazer a fome dos filhos dos leões,
verses.en_web: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
verses.en_bbe: Do you go after food for the she-lion, or get meat so that the young lions may have enough,

verses.en: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?
verses.pt: quando se agacham nos covis, e estão à espreita nas covas?
verses.en_web: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?
verses.en_bbe: When they are stretched out in their holes, and are waiting in the brushwood?

verses.en: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.
verses.pt: Quem prepara ao corvo o seu alimento, quando os seus pintainhos clamam a Deus e andam vagueando, por não terem o que comer?
verses.en_web: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
verses.en_bbe: Who gives in the evening the meat he is searching for, when his young ones are crying to God; when the young lions with loud noise go wandering after their food?
